rawLiteralNfcBoundary.reason: The primary API NFC-normalizes literal U2000 to U2002 and U2001 to U2003 before parsing. The byte-exact captures therefore omit those two raw literal forms. Their decimal/hex forms and the other seventeen literals are proved. The omitted raw literals remain unproved and writer-protected.

findings: Every captured non-ASCII whitespace identity remains distinct from ASCII space, including leading/trailing positions.
Decimal/hex, captured literal and supported named whitespace forms identify the same source body for their codepoint.
ASCII leading/trailing space and the empty edge identify the same native body, while the tested non-ASCII edges remain distinct.
Named eacute, ndash, AMP, colon, apos and NotEqualTilde share the native literal/decimal/hex class in these complete forms.
Named Tab/NewLine and numeric tab/newline identify a different body from a raw literal tab/newline, which shares the ASCII-space class.

The local graph reader parses emitted href and li id attributes through identical HTML semantics once. The earlier raw-href versus decoded-id diagnostic is retained privately and no native response was modified.
